text:
Nadia: quick brain dump — proposing a lightweight "residency handshake + circuit breaker" for multi-region writes. goal: stop tiny accidental cross-region blobs and give proxies a deterministic short-circuit during flaps.

Eli: short summary of the problem?

Nadia: today proxies either forward or try a lease, which on jitter leads to transient writes in the wrong region. those are rare but expensive to clean and risky for residency compliance.

Rex: what's the handshake look like?

Nadia: sketch: proxy asks resident control-plane for a signed short-lived handshake token (or uses cached one). token covers (tenant, resident_region, epoch, allowed_ops, ttl). proxies attach X-Residency-Handshake to forwarded writes. dataplane verifies token; if missing/invalid we run circuit-breaker logic.

Tori: what's the circuit-breaker rule?

Nadia: twofold: 1) soft mode (default): allow idempotent writes with token-missing but emit high-severity audit and a telemetry flag; 2) strict mode (opt-in per-tenant): reject any write lacking valid token with 409+route-hint. Circuit opens for a region if token-miss-rate > threshold.

Eli: how do tokens get cached at the edge? risk is control-plane blip causing mass misses.

Nadia: cache with refresh jitter, and we allow a small grace window where proxies can serve from stale token if token epoch matches recent accepted epoch. also shadow proxies (regional cache) can help.

Rex: security/compliance constraints?

Nadia: tenants with PII default to strict mode unless escrowed KMS + audit retention enabled. tokens are signed with tenant-scoped keys derived from control-plane master. every token use emits an immutable audit event.

Tori: operational asks: add metrics token-issuance-latency, token-miss-rate, circuit-open-per-region, denied-writes-by-tenant, and audit-export-failure. Also a single kill-switch to turn all tenants into strict-mode if needed.

Eli: tests: simulate control-plane outage, token cache expiry storms, and verify circuit transitions (closed->open->half-open->closed). include chaos test with 24h of mixed traffic.

Rex: runtime behavior: dataplane verification needs to be cheap (HMAC or ed25519) and reject quickly if token invalid to avoid wasting CPU.

Nadia: SDK UX: map 409 responses to a RetryWithRegion error that includes X-Resident-Region header so clients can rebind quickly. For soft-mode transient accepts SDK should surface a warning log + ephemeral flag in response.

infra-bot: created ticket ARCH-10007: residency-handshake-circuit-breaker + tokens + telemetry.

Tori: next steps: Nadia will draft RFC with token format, circuit thresholds, and rollout plan. I'll own telemetry proto. Eli will help with token signing implementation.

Nadia: thanks. will post the RFC link when ready. :white_check_mark:
